newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia says comfortable with interest rates.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia says comfortable with interest rates.

text.p: Malaysia is comfortable with its level of interest rates, if seen in the context of the region's development, Deputy Prime Minister and Finance Minister Anwar Ibrahim said in an interview aired on Monday.

"I think if you look around the region, it must be compared essentially to the development in the context of the region," Anwar said in an interview with Reuters Financial Television which was aired on Monday.
He was responding to a question about whether Malaysia would consider cutting interest rates after adhering to a firm monetary policy.
He said that Malaysia's interest rate policy should not be viewed against those of industrialised countries such as Japan, the United States or Europe.
"I think if you look at the regional context, the development has been fairly comforting," he said.
